title: When the Salt Burns
author: Petra Amberdale
blurb: Wendell Nystrom, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
